notes.content: Due to high demand, admission to SDSU is highly competitive. General admission information is available at: http://arweb.sdsu.edu/es/admissions/transfers/index.html

notes.content: The Communication major with a B.A. degree in liberal arts and sciences requires competency (successfully completing the third college semester or fifth college quarter) in one foreign language to fulfill graduation requirements.
notes.contentHtml: The Communication major with a B.A. degree in liberal arts and sciences requires competency (successfully completing the third college semester or fifth college quarter) in one foreign language to fulfill graduation requirements.

notes.content: The Communication major with a B.A in applied arts and sciences requires completion of three semesters of college mathematics or a statistical sequence. See catalog.
notes.contentHtml: The Communication major with a B.A in applied arts and sciences requires completion of three semesters of college mathematics or a statistical sequence.  See catalog.

notes.content: These prerequisite courses may not be taken Cr/NC and must be completed with a minimum grade point average of 2.75 and a grade of C (2.0) or better in each course. The General Education oral communication course will not be included in the computation of the required grade point average of 2.75.
